name: KPK USDC Prime
oneLiner: KPK USDC Prime is a KPK-curated Morpho V2 USDC vault targeting blue-chip collateral; shares accrue interest, absorb losses and redeem subject to liquidity.
collateral: USDC-denominated idle balances and lender positions in KPK-curated Morpho markets targeting blue-chip collateral such as WETH, WBTC, cbBTC and ETH liquid-staking tokens. Borrower collateral secures the underlying loans rather than being held directly by the vault; liquidation, oracle and market-liquidity risks remain, and shares are not direct claims on Circle's cash reserves.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposits exchange USDC for NAV-bearing shares. Borrower interest and configured fee-share accrual change assets per share; realized lending losses can reduce NAV. Withdraw/redeem burns shares for idle USDC and liquidity from the configured adapter; force-deallocation is separate and cannot create liquidity in fully borrowed markets. VaultV2 deliberately returns zero from maxWithdraw and maxRedeem as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum 0x4ef53d2caa51c447fdfeeedee8f07fd1962c9ee6 issues a proportional operational position in Morpho lending strategies over USDC. VaultV2 exit code burns shares against available assets and recognizes losses; holder exposure differs from the fiat-cash parent. At Ethereum block 26107704, asset()=0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, totalSupply()=28097145082426439535141891 raw 18-decimal shares and totalAssets()=29100078912490 raw 6-decimal USDC. One adapter 0x1d511811aca9d8817a3e50f29cadff6243a02902 enumerates 8 current market IDs; summed expectedSupplyAssets=29100078910236, idle underlying=2254; their sum equals totalAssets. All current positions have zero borrow shares and zero posted collateral. This is an operational proportional lending-position claim. It is not direct ownership of the parent issuer reserve, an independently signed financial reconciliation, or proof of legal segregation and insolvency priority.
